It demonstrates the power of the *divide-and-conquer* strategy, reducing a search space by half with each step. While linear search checks every element one by one (taking O(n) time), binary search achieves **O(log n)** performance—a staggering improvement for large datasets.

If the array isn't sorted, discarding half of it could delete your target.
